description: This file implements network worker thread management and socket communication for the Wesnoth game, including socket handling, data transmission, and error detection.

classes.name: _TCPsocket
classes.description: Internal structure representing a TCP socket with associated addresses and flags.

classes.name: buffer
classes.description: Buffer class encapsulating socket and data buffer for transmission.

classes.name: manager
classes.description: Network worker thread pool manager handling multiple threads for socket I/O.

methods.name: send_buf
methods.description: Sends data over a socket, handling non-blocking and partial sends.

methods.name: receive_buf
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, handling partial reads and socket errors.

methods.name: process_queue
methods.description: Main worker thread loop processing send/receive buffers.

methods.name: receive_data
methods.description: Queues a socket for receiving data.

methods.name: get_received_data
methods.description: Retrieves received data from the queue for a socket.

methods.name: queue_data
methods.description: Queues data to be sent over a socket.

methods.name: remove_buffers
methods.description: Removes all buffers associated with a socket.

methods.name: close_socket
methods.description: Closes a socket, cleaning up buffers and pending operations.

methods.name: detect_error
methods.description: Detects socket errors and returns a socket with an error.

methods.name: get_current_transfer_stats
methods.description: Returns current transfer statistics for a socket.
